stance_values.asserts: speaker directly advances a claim; not verified truth
stance_values.attributes_claim: speaker attributes or quotes another source
stance_values.rejects_or_corrects: excerpt rejects or corrects an earlier claim
stance_values.mixed: excerpt combines incompatible claims or qualifications

manual_additional_topics.incident_discussion: explicit discussion of the event without narrower theme
manual_additional_topics.scene_footage: speech from the scene without a stable factual claim

coding_unit: one contextually inspected passage; never equate speaker with publisher

relevance_values.incident_context_supported: local text supports a connection to this incident; does not establish the truth of claims
relevance_values.available_text_no_verified_incident_exce: readable text lacks sufficient self-contained incident context; title is not content proof

limitations: ASR cannot establish truth, speaker identity, irony, quotations or exact wording; confirm against original before publication.
